title: We Have Always Lived in the Castle
author: Shirley Jackson
summary: Eighteen-year-old Merricat lives with her sister and ailing uncle in a large house outside a village that shuns them, since poison killed the rest of the family years ago. A visiting cousin disturbs their routine.
readIf: you want a short, strange, beautifully written gothic with a narrator you cannot quite trust.
skipIf: you want a conventional plot or a clear moral.

pairings.reason: The author's other classic, which shares its sense of a woman and a house bound together.
Another novel where a house and a family's reputation shape everyone's behaviour.
A short, ambiguous classic with an unsettling narrator.
